label: Vision: real pixels, repeat-cache, changed image, and multimodal history
query: Qualify the installed model's image path through the real Osaurus HTTP runtime.
notes: Model-independent. Require image support: refusals, load failures and server errors fail rather than skip. Eight real-media requests (including streaming chat and a custom agent endpoint) score exact background colors, normal termination, visible answers, measured throughput, repeated-image cache hits and changed-media history and later recall of the latest attachment. Sampling comes from the bundle; only the output budget is explicit. This is bounded image qualification, not OCR/video or general caption quality.
